summary: Social-discussion sweep: operator pain (billing, silent failures), security/rogue-agent activity, vendor releases/support (OpenHands, DigitalOcean), plus infra primitives for memory and workflow steering. | Vendor-focused roundup: product releases (Cursor, OpenAI, OpenRouter, AWS Bedrock AgentCore), multiple high-severity GHSA advisories affecting agent runtimes/tools, plus operator-facing sandbox/runtime lessons from E2B and Daytona. Missing social/operator field reports in this shard. | GitHub OSS snapshot: several vendor releases (Vercel, Microsoft, Anthropic, OpenAI, Qwen) plus high-traction open-agent frameworks and new infra primitives (memory, security toolkits). No social/discussion reports in this shard; many repo-only projects need independent corroboration. | Package-level signals: mix of high-traction vendor extensions (OpenAI, AWS, New Relic, Upstash) and many MCP/agent infra libraries on PyPI/crates/npm. Several VS Code agent extensions surface concrete operator workflows; many PyPI/crates-only packages need corroboration.
